ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱卖出/离场形态（-26）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: The Vita Coco Company, doing business simply as Vita Coco, is an American beverage company which mainly sells coconut water. The largest brand globally in coconut/plant waters, Vita Coco has operations in 31 countries as of 2016.
profile.description_zh: Vita Coco Company（简称Vita Coco）是一家美国饮料公司，主要销售椰子水。作为全球椰子/植物水领域最大的品牌，截至2016年，Vita Coco的业务覆盖31个国家。
